verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a concrete, callable API surface for cart creation/updates (POST /merchant-cart createcart, getcart) as well as agent-toolkit tools like create_order/create_product that agents invoke via MCP/LangChain/etc., with runtime probes confirming the MCP server and npm package are live. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation of an agent successfully completing a full create-then-update cart round trip in production, and the cart creation flow is merchant-hosted/reverse-API rather than a single PayPal-hosted endpoint, adding integration complexity.
